exposure: sickle cell hemoglobinopathy (genotype AS and SS)
cohort: 225 pregnant women with sickle cell disease (SCD) and 100 age- and gravida-matched pregnant women with normal hemoglobin
finding: Pregnant women with SCD experience higher rates of antenatal and obstetric complications, including sickle cell crisis, jaundice, PIH, IUGR, and LSCS, compared to pregnant women without SCD.
